definitions.explanation: A kitchen appliance with burners used for cooking on top of.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧コンロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}し{忘|わす}れた→消し忘れる：noentry⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to turn off the gas stove.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧３⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧コンロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The kitchen has a three-burner stove.

notes:
コンロ derives from the Dutch word 'komfoor' (portable stove).

TYPES:
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧コンロ (gas stove)
- ⟦IH→IH：08906_aieichi⟧コンロ (induction cooktop)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧コンロ (electric stove)
- ⟦{卓上|たくじょう}→卓上：22894_takujou⟧コンロ (portable stove)
- ⟦{七輪|しちりん}→七輪：28597_shichirin⟧ (traditional charcoal stove)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to turn on the stove)
- コンロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to turn off the stove)
- コンロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clean the stove)
- ～⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧コンロ (X-burner stove)

In Japan, ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧コンロ has been traditional, but ⟦IH→IH：08906_aieichi⟧コンロ (induction) is becoming popular due to safety and ease of cleaning.
